GENERAL SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrolysis? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrolysis.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrolysis.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrolysis.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrolysis.

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.

   A. Only water vapour
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week

   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

22. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)
